<parameter=code>
# Fixed loop: click dots in reading order, inspect after each click.
def marks(fr):
    lines = fr.ascii.splitlines()
    out={}
    for ch,name in [('G','G'),('g','g'),('N','N')]:
        px=[(r,c) for r in range(10,54) for c in range(10,52) if lines[r][c]==ch]
        if px:
            rs=[x[0] for x in px]; cs=[x[1] for x in px]
            out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),len(px))
    return out

order = [((1,1),19,18),((1,2),19,24),((1,4),19,36),((2,5),25,42),((4,2),37,24)]
for cell,r,c in order:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    m = marks(current_frame)
    print('clicked',cell,'->',m,'done:',last_action_result.get('done'),'lvl:',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if 'G' not in m and 'g' not in m:
        print('RESET detected after',cell)
        break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('COMPLETED after',cell)
        break
</parameter>
